what: The performance energy (nature layers' levels) after 30 s of one conducted hand, from the real ConductEngine and the real PerformanceEnergy with the constants of content/content.json (riseBase 0.06, risePerVelocity 0.06, halfLifeSec 6, levels 0.2/0.45/0.7, hysteresis 0.05). Test: ConductPlayTests.TheEnergyAfter30Seconds_OfAHandHeldUp_OrConducting.

shares.note: A conducted note adds this share of a normal note's energy: the still share when the hand moves less than stillPalms (0.3 palms/s), else the active share.

hand: x 0.5 (the winds, at least 2 slots between notes, so at most every half beat); heights: high 0.15, middle 0.5, low 0.8 (0 top .. 1 bottom); movement = a circle of radius 0.1 at the given palms per second; the tracker at 30 and 6 pictures a second gives the same numbers
